title: Some man that wayfaring
html_source:
References a 10th century Anglo-Saxon poem The Wanderer. Much of the text about a man in exile from his homeland, kin, and Creator applies to both Stephen and Bloom. It’s worth reading the whole poem. http://www.vqronline.org/essay/wanderer-anglo-saxon-poem-translated-jeffrey-hopkins

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: A more directly relevant source for Joyce (apparently) is the Life of St. Cuthbert (by Aelfric) which he had in his library in Trieste and several parts of which are excerpted in this section. See this link for more details.
